claims.claim: Forward Gaussian chain and closed-form marginal; latent states have the same dimensionality as data
Negative ELBO decomposes into prior KL, posterior reverse KLs and discrete reconstruction term
Posterior q(x[t-1]|x[t],x0) is tractable Gaussian; its variance is beta[t]*(1-alpha_bar[t-1])/(1-alpha_bar[t])
Epsilon prediction reparameterizes reverse mean; simplified MSE drops the original time-dependent coefficient
Training samples one t; sampling uses T sequential denoiser calls with last-step noise set to zero
T1000; beta linear .0001 to .02; U-Net with groupnorm and attention at16x16
CIFAR10 IS9.46±.11; train-reference FID3.17; test-reference FID5.24; NLL upper bound3.75 bits/dim
Fixed-variance original variational objective FID13.22 for mu prediction,13.51 for epsilon prediction; simple epsilon loss3.17
claims.qualification: Supports interaction of parameterization and objective, not a universal theorem about epsilon superiority

claims.claim: True variational objective NLL upper bound3.70, simple loss3.75; better samples do not imply better likelihood
LSUN Bedroom large4.90, Church7.89, Cat19.75 FID
CIFAR35.7M parameters; high-resolution114M; large Bedroom256M; EMA.9999; reported final experiments trained once and checkpoint selected by minimum FID

claims.claim: Follow-up Improved DDPM: last quarter of linear schedule nearly pure noise; skipping up to 20% of reverse process barely hurts FID on ImageNet 64; cosine schedule; linear schedule better at 256x256; learned variances with Lhybrid (lambda=0.001) give near-optimal FID with 100 steps; DDIM better below 50 steps; CIFAR10 NLL 2.94 with Lvlb (FID 11.47) vs Lhybrid 3.17 (FID 3.19)
